reading: Anthropic makes Claude, a computer program that people can talk to.
The company started just five years ago.
Shares are small parts of a company that people can buy.
On Thursday, people will be able to buy its shares on a stock market.
Each share will cost $83 when trading starts.
The company is now worth up to $1.5 trillion.
Anthropic wants to grow, so it is looking for more money.
Some people who put money into the company worry about its future profits.
Profits are the money a business keeps after paying its costs.

vocabulary.definition: Small parts of a company that people can buy.
Having a value of a certain amount of money.
Feel that something bad may happen.
Money a business keeps after paying its costs.
